en.title: Pronouncing Romanian X Between Vowels
en.summary: You pronounce the Romanian letter x as gz when it sits between two vowels.

sections.title: The sound
paragraphs: The letter x often sounds like gz. A letter is a written sign of the alphabet. You hear this sound between two vowels. A vowel is a sound made with open air and no touch in the mouth. Listen to the word (examen) /e.ˈɡza.men/, which means exam.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: You make two sounds together. First, you touch the back of your tongue to the roof of your mouth. You use your voice to make the g sound. Then you move your tongue near your upper teeth. You push air through a narrow space to make z. Touch your throat and feel it shake.

sections.title: Reading rules
paragraphs: Look at the letters around the letter x. When x sits between two vowels, you say gz. The word (examen) /e.ˈɡza.men/ shows this pattern clearly. The letter x comes after the vowel e. It also comes before the vowel a. Therefore you say gz in (examen) /e.ˈɡza.men/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not say ks instead of gz. A voiceless sound is a sound where the voice is off. Do not make a voiceless sound like x in 'box'. Keep your voice active when you say (examen) /e.ˈɡza.men/. Connect g and z smoothly without a pause. Practice the two sounds together.
